mapper.sql: id, platform, build_number, version_name, download_url, sha256, apk_size_bytes, release_notes, force_update, is_published, request_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select from app_releases where platform = #{platform} and is_published = true and build_number > #{buildNumber} order by build_number desc limit 1
